# releaser

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-bots/cmd/releaser"
```

Command releaser drives every release of a repository through its Release issue \("Release: vX.Y.Z", label release\) on the project board.

```
releaser plan       on every push to develop: plan the next release
releaser cut        cut the release branch and its pull request
releaser prepare    the checks of cut, without cutting
releaser verify     before the release branch is finalized
releaser complete   after the GitHub release is published
```

Each command comments its checks on the Release issue and exits 1 when one fails. GitHub is reached with the token in GH\_TOKEN \(or GITHUB\_TOKEN\), normally an installation token of the BlanketOps Environments Releaser App.
